enriched_activities.desc: Lies down on bed. Pulls blanket over body. Closes eyes. Breathes steadily. Turns to left side. Adjusts pillow. Remains sleeping. Turns to right side. Pulls blanket up. Slight movement of arm. Remains still. Continues sleeping. Turns to back. Stretches legs. Pulls blanket. Breathes deeply. Remains sleeping.

Wakes up. Sits up on bed. Stands up. Walks to bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on tap. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Spits into sink. Rinses mouth with water. Washes face with water. Picks up towel. Dries face. Turns off tap. Turns off light. Walks out of bathroom.

Walks to kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out milk and bread. Closes refrigerator. Takes plate from cupboard. Places bread on plate. Opens microwave. Places plate in microwave. Presses start button. Waits. Opens microwave. Takes out plate. Pours milk into glass. Sits at table. Eats breakfast. Drinks milk. Stands up. Washes dishes. Dries hands.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and packing bag for university
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bedroom. Opens wardrobe. Takes out shirt. Takes out pants. Closes wardrobe. Takes off pajamas. Puts on shirt. Puts on pants. Puts on socks. Puts on shoes. Opens backpack. Places notebook in backpack. Places pen in backpack. Places laptop in backpack. Zips backpack. Picks up phone. Places phone in pocket. Picks up keys. Walks out of bedroom.

Walks to bus stop. Stands at bus stop. Checks phone. Bus arrives. Boards bus. Taps card on reader. Finds seat. Sits down. Looks out window. Checks phone. Bus stops. Stands up. Walks to exit. Exits bus. Walks to university campus. Enters building.

enriched_activities.activity: Attending lectures and tutorials at university
enriched_activities.desc: Enters lecture hall. Finds seat. Sits down. Takes out notebook. Takes out pen. Opens notebook. Writes notes. Listens to lecturer. Raises hand. Asks question. Listens to answer. Continues writing. Closes notebook. Stands up. Walks to tutorial room. Sits down. Opens laptop. Types notes. Discusses with group. Closes laptop. Stands up. Walks out.

Walks to campus cafeteria. Stands in line. Picks up tray. Selects sandwich. Selects drink. Pays at cashier. Takes tray to table. Sits down. Unwraps sandwich. Eats sandwich. Drinks beverage. Wipes mouth with napkin. Stands up. Returns tray. Walks to library.

enriched_activities.activity: Studying in the library and working on group assignments
enriched_activities.desc: Enters library. Finds desk. Sits down. Opens laptop. Turns on laptop. Logs in. Opens assignment file. Reads instructions. Types. Highlights text. Opens browser. Searches for reference. Reads article. Takes notes. Discusses with group members. Shares screen. Points at screen. Listens to feedback. Edits document. Saves file. Closes laptop. Stands up. Packs bag.

Walks to bus stop. Waits. Checks phone. Bus arrives. Boards bus. Taps card. Finds seat. Sits down. Looks out window. Listens to music. Bus stops. Stands up. Exits bus. Walks home. Unlocks door. Enters house.

Enters kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out vegetables and meat. Closes refrigerator. Takes out cutting board. Takes out knife. Cuts vegetables. Turns on stove. Places pan on stove. Pours oil. Adds vegetables. Stirs with spatula. Adds meat. Stirs. Adds sauce. Turns off stove. Takes plate. Serves food onto plate. Sits at table. Eats dinner. Drinks water. Stands up. Washes dishes. Dries hands.

enriched_activities.activity: Changing into work uniform and preparing for part-time shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bedroom. Opens wardrobe. Takes out uniform. Closes wardrobe. Takes off clothes. Puts on uniform shirt. Puts on uniform pants. Puts on shoes. Checks phone. Picks up bag. Places phone in bag. Places keys in bag. Zips bag. Walks out of bedroom.
Walks to bus stop. Waits. Checks phone. Bus arrives. Boards bus. Taps card. Finds seat. Sits down. Looks out window. Bus stops. Stands up. Exits bus. Walks to workplace. Enters building.

Stands at counter. Greets customer. Scans items. Takes payment. Gives receipt. Bags items. Says goodbye. Stocks shelves. Folds clothes. Assists customer. Answers phone. Cleans counter. Rearranges display. Checks inventory. Takes break. Drinks water. Returns to counter.
Walks to bus stop. Waits. Checks phone. Bus arrives. Boards bus. Taps card. Finds seat. Sits down. Looks out window. Bus stops. Stands up. Exits bus. Walks home. Unlocks door. Enters house.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on tap. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Spits. Rinses mouth. Washes face. Dries face with towel. Turns off tap. Turns off light. Walks to bedroom.

Lies down on bed. Pulls blanket. Closes eyes. Turns to side. Adjusts pillow. Remains sleeping. Breathes. Slight movement. Pulls blanket. Continues sleeping. Turns to back. Stretches arm. Yawns. Closes eyes again. Remains still.
